title: Troubleshoot latency and performance issues with X-Ray and CloudWatch [Hands-On]

cues.en: Hello my friends and welcome to this, your hands-on tutorial on how to troubleshoot latency and performance issues of your machine learning models.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到排查機器學習模型延遲與效能問題的實作。

cues.en: Indeed, performance issues can happen while your machine learning model is in production.
cues.zh: 正式環境可能有效能問題。

cues.en: You can have some latency and fortunately there are some tools within AWS that allow to monitor this or troubleshoot this.
cues.zh: 可能延遲，幸好 AWS 有工具可監控、排查。

cues.en: And this is very important to know for the exam.
So actually this tutorial will be very exam oriented.
I'm just gonna show you these three tools because three tools allow to troubleshoot this.
cues.zh: 只展示三個工具，有三種工具能排查。

cues.en: I won't do any demo, it's just to give you some visuals so that you can remember better these tools in order to increase your chance of cracking these performance issues,
cues.zh: 不做完整示範，只提供畫面，幫你記住，提高回答效能問題

cues.en: troubleshooting questions in case they come up at the exam.
So first, before I show you these three tools, just remember that they're not to be confused with Amazon SageMaker Model Monitor, which only monitors your models in production,
cues.zh: 展示前，別與 SageMaker Model Monitor 混淆，講者表示它只監控正式環境模型，

cues.en: like remember the CPU utilization, the memory at the endpoint level.
Now the services that I'm about to show you are more the ones used to troubleshoot performance issues, you know, to understand the root of the problem.
cues.zh: 接下來服務，更用於找效能問題根因。

cues.en: Okay, so there we go.
Let's start with the first one, which is actually an AWS service, which is AWS X-Ray.
That's the first one, X-Ray, to analyze and debug your applications.
Here we go, welcome to X-Ray.
And you will see actually that it is now integrated into CloudWatch.
This was the previous AWS X-Ray service that you just saw, but now it is indeed in CloudWatch.
cues.zh: 剛是舊服務入口，現在已在 CloudWatch。

cues.en: Let me scroll back up a bit.
There we go, Traces X-Ray.
Now integrated into CloudWatch, X-Ray helps developers analyze and debug distributed applications such as those built using a microservices architecture.
cues.zh: 協助開發者分析、除錯分散式應用，例如微服務架構。

cues.en: With X-Ray, you can understand how your application and its underlying services are performing and identify and troubleshoot the root cause of performance issues
cues.zh: 理解應用與底層服務效能，找出並排查問題根因，

cues.en: such as the ones of your machine learning models and errors.
Okay, so very important to remember this for the exam, a question might come up.
Now, how to use X-Ray?
Well that's thanks to service map, server-side and client-side latency detection.
cues.zh: Service map，伺服器端、用戶端延遲偵測。

cues.en: Use the X-Ray service map to visually detect node and edge latency distribution and see relationships between services and resources in your application in real time.
cues.zh: 用服務地圖視覺化節點、邊的延遲分布，即時看服務與資源關係。

cues.en: Okay?
So through this service map, you will connect the dots and that's how you will reach the root cause of the performance issues such as latency.
cues.zh: 連起線索，找延遲等問題根因。

cues.en: Okay, and here's the service map.
Let's click View Service Map.
This is where you will have all your nodes and if you're interested to dive deeper, you can set up this demo app and create a sample application with CloudFormation, but we won't do it.
cues.zh: 這裡有全部節點，想深入可用 CloudFormation 建範例應用，但這裡不做。

cues.en: This tutorial, as I said, is more exam oriented, just so that you can also crack the questions on troubleshooting performance issues with three possible solutions.
cues.zh: 如前所說考試導向，了解三種排查方案。

cues.en: So we already covered one, X-Ray, and now let me show you the second one, which is this time, not a service, but a feature.
cues.zh: 第一 X-Ray，第二不是獨立服務，而是功能。

cues.en: And once again, of CloudWatch.
Let me enter CloudWatch here and then remember this.
The second solution to troubleshoot performance issues of your machine learning model is CloudWatch Lambda Insights, CloudWatch Lambda Insights, and here it is.
cues.zh: 第二方案 CloudWatch Lambda Insights。

cues.en: As I told you, it's a feature, not a service of CloudWatch.
cues.zh: 是 CloudWatch 功能，不是獨立服務。

cues.en: Okay, so let's go to Lambda Insights.
Once again, I'm just gonna show you the dashboard.
First of all, you have to turn on Lambda Insights.
It is by default turned off and then you can add it to a dashboard.
cues.zh: 預設關閉，再加入儀表板。

cues.en: Right now we don't have any dashboard, but if we click this, we can create a new one, for example, apply to machine learning.
cues.zh: 目前沒有，但按這裡可建立，例如用在機器學習。

cues.en: Okay?
So that's the second solution.
Remember this CloudWatch Lambda Insights.
And now the third one also to remember for the exam, which is once again another feature of CloudWatch also called something Insight.
cues.zh: 第三也要記，另一個 CloudWatch 的 Insights 功能。

cues.en: The third solution to troubleshoot the performance issues of your machine learning models is CloudWatch Logs Insights.
cues.zh: 第三方案 CloudWatch Logs Insights。

cues.en: All right, CloudWatch Logs Insights.
Here it is, another CloudWatch feature as we just said.
And here we go.
This is what the Logs Insights feature of CloudWatch dashboard looks like.
So you see here it looks a bit more advanced.
You have more features, more detailed features, some of which are of course related to machine learning.
cues.zh: 更多、更詳細功能，部分與機器學習有關。

cues.en: Indeed, if we click Browse Log Groups here, you will see that a lot of the log groups are designed for machine learning, like for example, this one, machine learning in CodeBuild.
cues.zh: Browse log groups，看到很多機器學習日誌群組，例如 CodeBuild 的 machine-learning。

cues.en: But we also have of course, machine learning model endpoint for SageMaker and many other ones.
cues.zh: 也有 SageMaker 模型端點等。

cues.en: Canvas classification, Canvas regression for the SageMaker endpoints, inference components, training jobs, and SageMaker Studio.
cues.zh: Canvas 分類、Canvas 迴歸、推論元件、訓練工作、SageMaker Studio。

cues.en: Okay, so you see, that's why you have to remember that CloudWatch Logs Insights are very useful to troubleshoot latency and performance issues of your machine learning models.
cues.zh: 所以記得，Logs Insights 很適合排查模型延遲與效能。

cues.en: All right, that should really be enough for you to crack those questions if they come up at the exam.
cues.zh: 這些足夠回答相關考題。

cues.en: Now I look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial.
And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
